nodes.description: LendingPool.deposit external payable nonReentrant: validates reserve/amount, mints aTokens and forwards the underlying to the core
LendingPool.borrow nonReentrant: checks collateral, fees and stable-rate limits, then updates core state and disburses funds
LendingPool.repay payable nonReentrant: repays a loan wholly or partially on behalf of a user
LendingPool.flashLoan nonReentrant: lends liquidity to an arbitrary receiver contract and requires repayment plus fee in the same transaction
LendingPool.liquidationCall payable nonReentrant: delegatecalls the liquidation manager to liquidate an undercollateralized position
LendingPool.redeemUnderlying nonReentrant onlyOverlyingAToken: burns aTokens and transfers the underlying back to the user
LendingPool.setUserUseReserveAsCollateral nonReentrant: toggles collateral usage after a balance-decrease check
LendingPool.rebalanceStableBorrowRate nonReentrant: rescales a user's stable borrow rate when market conditions drift
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnDeposit onlyLendingPool: compounds indexes and records the deposit in reserve state
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnBorrow onlyLendingPool: updates reserve and user borrow state and returns the new rate
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnRedeem onlyLendingPool: compounds indexes and updates collateral flags on redeem
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnFlashLoan onlyLendingPool: distributes the flashloan fee into the liquidity index
LendingPoolCore.transferToUser onlyLendingPool: sends ERC20 via safeTransfer or ETH via call.value to a user
LendingPoolCore.transferToReserve payable onlyLendingPool: pulls tokens in, or accepts ETH and refunds the excess
LendingPoolCore.transferToFeeCollectionAddress payable onlyLendingPool: forwards fees as token or ETH
LendingPoolCore.liquidateFee payable onlyLendingPool: transfers liquidated origination fees to the fee collector
LendingPoolCore.initReserve onlyLendingPoolConfigurator: initializes reserve data and registers the reserve in the list
LendingPoolCore internal routine that recomputes reserve interest rates and stores block.timestamp
AToken.redeem: cumulates interest, burns aTokens and calls pool.redeemUnderlying
AToken.mintOnDeposit onlyLendingPool: mints aTokens matching a deposit
AToken.burnOnLiquidation onlyLendingPool: burns the liquidated aToken amount
AToken.transferOnLiquidation onlyLendingPool: moves aTokens to the liquidator
AToken._transfer override: enforces the balance-decrease allowance before moving balances
AToken.executeTransferInternal: cumulates both parties, updates redirected balances and performs the transfer
AToken.cumulateBalanceInternal: mints accrued interest and refreshes the user index
AToken internal routine that adjusts redirectedBalances of a redirection target
AToken.redirectInterestStream: redirects the caller's interest to a target address
AToken.redirectInterestStreamOf: third-party redirection guarded by an allowance
AToken.allowInterestRedirectionTo: grants/revokes an interest-redirection allowance
AToken.isTransferAllowed: view helper delegating the health-factor check to the data provider
LendingPoolLiquidationManager.liquidationCall: validates the position and performs the collateral/principal swap via delegatecall
Liquidation manager helper that converts principal amounts into liquidation bonus amounts using the price oracle
LendingPoolDataProvider.calculateUserGlobalData: aggregates ETH balances, LTV, liquidation threshold and health factor
LendingPoolDataProvider.balanceDecreaseAllowed: checks whether a balance decrease keeps the position healthy
LendingPoolDataProvider internal health factor computation from collateral, borrows and fees
LendingPoolAddressesProvider.updateImplInternal: creates a new upgradeable proxy or upgrades an existing one
LendingPoolAddressesProvider.setLendingPoolImpl onlyOwner: swaps the lending pool implementation
Proxy._delegate: inline-assembly delegatecall that forwards all calldata to the implementation
Proxy._fallback: calls _willFallback then delegates to _implementation()
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.changeAdmin ifAdmin: rewrites the admin slot
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeTo ifAdmin: rewrites the implementation slot
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall payable ifAdmin: upgrades and delegatecalls initialization data
Ownable._transferOwnership: writes the new owner address into storage
Ownable.transferOwnership onlyOwner: transfers ownership to a new account
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: low-level call to an untrusted token with optional return decoding
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom: encodes transferFrom calldata and routes it through callOptionalReturn
VersionedInitializable.isConstructor: uses extcodesize to detect constructor context
CoreLibrary.calculateLinearInterest: linear interest from block.timestamp delta, in ray
CoreLibrary.calculateCompoundedInterest: exponential interest using rayPow over the timestamp delta
ERC20._transfer internal: debits and credits the _balances mapping
ERC20._mint internal: increases total supply and credits an account
ERC20._burn internal: decreases total supply and debits an account
ERC20.transferFrom: moves tokens using the caller's allowance
ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier: mutex based on _guardCounter increment and comparison
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize payable: one-time implementation set plus delegatecall of init data

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the depositor and as the recipient of minted aTokens in deposit
msg.sender is the borrower whose global data is validated and who receives the borrowed funds
msg.sender repays on behalf of _onBehalfOf and supplies msg.value for ETH repayments
msg.sender triggers the liquidation delegatecall into the liquidation manager
msg.sender is the liquidator receiving collateral or aTokens
msg.sender cannot grant an interest-redirection allowance to itself
require(msg.sender == interestRedirectionAllowances[_from]) gates redirection on behalf of another user
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == _owner before swapping a protocol implementation
ifAdmin compares msg.sender with the admin slot and delegates non-admin callers
onlyLendingPool requires msg.sender == lendingPoolAddress before any payout
onlyLendingPool protects fee transfers from arbitrary callers
onlyLendingPoolConfigurator checks msg.sender against the configured configurator address
_willFallback requires msg.sender != proxy admin to block admin-triggered fallback delegation
transferFrom moves tokens using the allowance of msg.sender
block.timestamp is embedded in the Deposit event payload

block.timestamp is recorded in liquidation and fee-liquidation events
lendingPoolAddress state variable is compared with msg.sender inside onlyLendingPool
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the _owner state variable
_admin() sloads the ADMIN_SLOT storage slot to authorize callers
_implementation() sloads the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT storage slot before delegating

ERC20._transfer updates the _balances mapping
transferFrom decreases the _allowances mapping of the caller

burnOnLiquidation burns the liquidated aTokens

LendingPool.liquidationCall delegatecalls the liquidation manager with encoded arguments

borrow calls updateStateOnBorrow to persist the new debt

flashLoan hands funds and control to the untrusted receiver contract before checking repayment
flashLoan finalizes accounting through updateStateOnFlashLoan
